scores.evidence: The Mermaid loop diagram (loop-diagram, flowchart TD) has Japanese labels that are easy to read at 390 px (mobile-jp-04/05). The code, diff and prompt blocks render cleanly. Two tables break row labels mid-word, and in practice-steps the step circles 3-6 do not match the ①-⑤ in the titles (mobile-jp-17/18, desktop-jp-12/13).

No text-only screens on desktop-jp or mobile-jp. Desktop chars-per-line median is 39 (target 30-40), and every section mixes a table, definitions, a figure, code or a check. practice-steps reads as a long run on mobile (mobile-jp-17 to 19), and the doubled numbering makes it harder to follow.

Everything is in Japanese, and the English glosses appear on first use. Words break awkwardly in table header cells: 「デスクトッ/プアプリ」 (mobile-jp-07), 「デスクトップアプ/リ」, 「クラウドセッショ/ン」 and 「エディタの補/完」 (desktop-jp-05, desktop-jp-02), and 「チャット/AI」 (mobile-jp-03). No privacy data appears on any screen opened.

mustFix.issue: The first-column labels break inside words at both widths: 「デスクトッ / プアプリ」 on mobile, and 「デスクトップアプ / リ」 and 「クラウドセッショ / ン」 with one-character orphans on desktop.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the row labels so each fits on one line or breaks at a word boundary, e.g. 「CLI」「IDE拡張」「アプリ」「クラウド」, and keep the full names (ターミナルCLI・デスクトップアプリ・クラウドセッション) in the second-column text. Or turn the table into a definitions block, where the term gets the full width.

mustFix.issue: The first-column labels break mid-word: 「エディタ / の補完」 and 「チャット / AI」 on mobile, and 「エディタの補 / 完」 with an orphaned 完 on desktop.
mustFix.fix: Use shorter labels such as 「チャット」「補完」「Claude Code」. The header 「道具」 and the second column already make clear what each one is.

mustFix.issue: The reader numbers the steps 1-6 in circles, while the titles carry their own 「①②」「③」「④」「⑤」. Step circle 3 reads 「①② 質問して…」 and circle 6 reads 「⑤ コミットして確かめる」, which gives learners two numbering systems that disagree.
mustFix.fix: Remove the circled numbers from the titles (e.g. 「質問して、変更を1つ頼む」「予想してから差分を見る」) and keep the link to the example in the body text, which already says 「1-5の①を送り…」 and 「1-5の⑤を送り…」.

niceToHave: example-steps: the step circles 1-5 repeat the ①-⑤ in each title (「1 ① 何をするプロジェクトか聞く」, desktop-jp-09). Dropping the circled numbers from the titles would remove the duplication. They can stay only if practice-steps keeps referring to them.

install-node: the 'pitfall' variant draws a red alert box with an error icon around a reassuring message (「Node.jsは先に入れなくてかまいません」, mobile-jp-10, desktop-jp-07). 'info' or 'tip' would fit the tone better.
check-quiz q5 option a and q7 option b each leave a single character (「る」) on the second line on desktop (desktop-jp-15, desktop-jp-16). A slightly shorter wording would avoid it.
reader: the glossary side panel lists 「エージェントループ」 twice, once as 「エージェントループ (agentic loop)」 and once without the alias, but the lesson glossary has a single entry (desktop-jp-01 and later).
reader: the flashcard hint says 「クリックまたはスペースキーでめくる」 on mobile, where 'tap' would fit (mobile-jp-26).
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson, because drafts are not in course.json (known behaviour).
summary: lessonHash sha256:eb6d40faa5d6fe69 matches the expected value. metrics.json shows no hard failures: no overflow, console, Mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors, and no text-only screens. Desktop chars-per-line median is 39 (target 30-40). No personal data appears on any screen opened. The diagram, code and prompt blocks read well at 390 px. The fixes needed are to shorten the row labels in surfaces-table and loop-table so Japanese words stop breaking mid-word, and to remove the circled numbers from the practice-steps titles so they no longer clash with the reader's 1-6 step numbers.
